shows.title: Heart of a Dog
shows.description: Written in 1925, Heart of a Dog follows a celebrated Moscow surgeon whose experiment transforms a stray dog into a man—with chaotic and unsettling consequences. Blending satire, absurdist humor, and philosophical inquiry, Bulgakov's story explores scientific ambition, social engineering, and the dangers of attempting to redesign human nature.

shows.title: Redcliffe A New Musical
shows.description: Set against the backdrop of 18th Century England, Redcliffe is an extraordinary new musical inspired by the haunting true story of William Critchard and Richard Arnold in Redcliffe, Bristol.

shows.title: The Apology
shows.description: The Apology is an act of theatrical imagination: a ritual in which V conjures her dead father to confront the abuse he inflicted on her as a child.

shows.title: Purpose
shows.description: From civil rights leaders to pastors and congressmen, the Jasper dynasty is a pillar of Black American Politics – with a reputation to protect. When a snowstorm traps three generations under one roof, family secrets claw their way to the surface.

shows.title: Afterbirth
shows.description: A funny, furious and unflinching story about the disorienting reality of life after birth, from Royal Court Associate Playwright Nina Segal (Cow|Deer, Antigone Exits).

shows.title: The Briar Patch
shows.description:
Dara is learning to live with the blank spaces – conversations she can't remember, the occasional hallucination. 

But when scandal rocks her community and a family friend is arrested, Dara starts asking questions. The answers risk pulling her life apart.

shows.title: Working Men
shows.description:
A quantity surveyor, a building contractor and a project manager walk onto a council estate. 

What starts as another routine site visit could become the day that defines the rest of their lives.
